thread:
jia: Quick heads-up: coordinating runtime+router+console rollout during quiet window tomorrow 23:00 UTC. Need pins, sticky policy, and rollback CLI. @deploy-bot please reserve.

deploy-bot: Wave created: wave-20240715-07 window=60m. Canary route=/canary/wave-20240715-07/*; run deploy-bot details --wave wave-20240715-07 for full metadata.

omar: Proposed pins: runtime=2.5.0, router=2.0.0, console=1.1.0. Fallbacks: runtime=2.4.1, router=1.9.4, console=1.0.3. Note: runtime 2.5.0 toggles KV-aware batching; router needs header `x-kv-prefetch: true` opt-in.

lex: For canary route please set sticky_ttl=3600 and sticky_key=kv-id to keep affinity. Also set router env X_PREFETCH_MODE=permissive for canary.

infra-oncall: Infra quick: eu-west runtime pool median free mem 19%, kv headroom 13%. Recommend prewarm 3 pods and eviction_grace=75s. I'll schedule prewarm 20m prior.

jia: Rollback criteria: auto rollback if 5xx >1.6x baseline for 3m OR p99 /v1/generate >1.8s sustained 2m. Rollback command example: deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240715-07 --to runtime=2.4.1,router=1.9.4,console=1.0.3 --reason="metric_trip"

omar: QA hooks: EVAL_SAMPLE=150 and DIFF_THRESH=4% on console canary. We'll sample model outputs and post diffs to the wave ticket.

lex: Also bump traces TTL to 7d and enable 1% full payload sampling for the wave to aid debugging.

jia: Plan: 3% -> 15% -> 50% with manual hold between steps. Start in eu-west only, then open us-east after green.

deploy-bot: Canary steering and alerts wired to #eng-sre and #eng-releases. Preflight run required 30m before window: deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240715-07

infra-oncall: Prewarm commands: kubectl -n runtime scale deploy/runtime-canary --replicas=6 && kubectl -n runtime exec job/prefill -- /usr/local/bin/prefill --prefixes "user,session"

omar: Please ack monitoring coverage for 23:00-00:00 UTC.

jia: ack; I'll monitor API metrics and canary dashboards.

lex: ack; watching router stickiness and batching efficiency.

infra-oncall: ack; infra and eviction signals covered.

jia: Great. Adding release note stub to wave: "runtime 2.5.0: KV-aware batching; router 2.0.0: opt-in prefetch header and sticky-key routing; console 1.1.0: telemetry improvements." Closing until preflight output.
